articles.summary: Unlock deeper contract visibility with our new Dashboard, delivering real‑time metrics and visual insights into active vs. expired agreements. Automatically classify every agreement by Entity Type (Customer or Vendor) and Status (Active, Inactive, Unknown), and keep your library clean with AI‑powered duplicate detection. Plus, easily share any view via CSV, preview PDFs inline with beta citations, and set document types on upload for perfect categorization—everything you need for smarter, faster contract management.
articles.title: Product Update: Dashboard + More

articles.summary: Tired of contracts buried in inboxes, Google Drive, or DocuSign accounts? This guide walks you through how to manually find every signed agreement across your business—and how to centralize them into a single, organized repository. Whether you’re prepping for a fundraising round, an audit, or just trying to avoid auto-renewal nightmares, this step-by-step process will help you regain control. Plus, learn why a solution like Docsum can save hours and reduce risk.
articles.title: Contract Chaos? How to Centralize Every Agreement Across Email, Google Drive, and DocuSign
